teacher_info.teaching_style:
Language learning is a skill, skill in receiving (listening and reading), and in producing the language (writing and speaking). You may be struggling with one or more of these. The key is practice. There's a saying: "If you don't use it, you lose it". It means that if you don't continue to practice or use a skill, you might lose that ability. In your case, if you don't practice what you've learned so far, you will likely forget and lose those language skills.
I use learner-centered and interactive methods, so you can expect to learn English in a relaxed environment with lots of practice, improving your grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and fluency.

I look forward to meeting you!

pro_course_detail.title: English for Business Purposes
pro_course_detail.description:
Business English is a type of English that has a specific purpose. It is the type of English that is used in an official or business setting. It is the language of the international workplace which means that once you master it you can effectively use it to communicate with any other professionals for example your boss, co-workers or any other business professional in any part of the world. In a globally connected world, Business English is becoming increasingly important as more and more companies need their staff to be highly knowledgeable when it comes to business language.

During our lessons, my goal is to help you communicate effectively with others in a business environment.

 I will be teaching you topics on
1- Business English reading/writing (this includes both business letters and resumes)
2- Business phrases 
3- Terms used during sales 
4- Advertising 
5- Marketing

Book a lesson with me and I will definitely provide you with everything you need to be fluent and confident in the business world. Allow me to help you pursue your dreams!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you have troubles using your English skills to form easy flowing conversations? Do you desire to improve your spoken English quickly and effectively? Are you worried that you might run out of what to talk about in English? Don't worry, Let me help you! 

During this lesson I will be teaching you how to effectively hold a conversation in English 
We will be looking at:
1- The most frequently used English words
2- Common structures and sentence patterns 
3- Common expressions 
4- Common phrasal verbs 
5- Idioms 

Please note that in addition to the mentioned topics, I will be coming up with conversational topics that we will both be discussing in order to help you be more comfortable with speaking English for example the topic can be travel, music or even childhood memories. We will then use that to practice as the topics will be relating to what you will come across in your daily life. This will definitely benefit your English conversation practice and I guarantee you that when we are done, you will be able to hold a proper conversation with anyone even a native speaker.

Looking forward to helping you. Feel free to book a lesson, it will be worth it!

pro_course_detail.title: Basic Conversation Topic
pro_course_detail.description:
OVERVIEW.
Speaking with a foreigner can be daunting, no matter how well you have mastered grammar and vocabulary. If you have a fundamental understanding of English, but you haven't spent a lot of time speaking, this course will help you easily start your first conversations in English.

GOAL.
To build your confidence, learn to talk about several common daily topics. In addition, you will gain much-needed knowledge of grammar while I correct answers and corrects your errors.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Shona
pro_course_detail.description:
Shona is a language that is very easy to learn, with my help you can become a confident shona speaker. We will cover 

1. Greetings and Introduction as well as etiquette and common norms of shona society.
2. Family structures and names ( unique different from the rest of the world)
3. Stable shona food and table manners 
4. Honorific/formal speech vs Casual speech
5. Slang and modern day terms

pro_course_detail.title: Interview practice & Resume (CV) Editing
pro_course_detail.description:
I can help you land your dream English job if you take my class. 


Your CV will be edited by me, and I will make it as clear as possible in English. You will learn all the possible questions you may encounter in an interview about your personality and work ethic in this lesson. 


As a result, you will:

1. Leave a lot more confident about your responses to your interview questions.

2. Leave with a pdf document of all the possible interview questions and answers to accompany them. 

3. A well written resume (CV)


I would appreciate if you could send me your CV (preferably as a word document) at least 24 hours prior to the class. In class, we'll discuss all the changes that I believe should be made to it to make it sound as crisp as possible. 




Emergencies are also acceptable, but please let me know.
